text.text:
A simple breakfast with a portion that felt just right for me. I think the croissant would taste even better if it were a bit crunchier!

The space at here is clean and airy, making it a really comfortable place to start the day. The staff were also very friendly and welcoming 😊

The tiramisu was a bit too much egg flavour for my taste, would appreciate it if this could be adjusted to make the flavor more balanced!

text.text:
I saw my family recommend this place and happened to be passing by the Zhongshan MRT station.
I decided to stop by this afternoon. The small space has 7 counter seats and 5 double beds, making it comfortable and not cramped.
It's pet-friendly and has no floor space.
I'd tried the Sicilian Sparkling Coffee from a chain called xx before, and I was a bit nervous, but it turned out to be delicious.
The waiter was worried that the bubbles would prevent the sausage dog from floating, so he added some ice cubes for me and let me add them myself. It turned out surprisingly well. 🤣
Since I had to eat later, I asked for a smaller portion of the grilled warm salad, so I'm not sure if the photo shows the correct amount. $180, but the warm salad sprinkled with spices was really delightful! The potatoes could be a little softer, but the rest of the texture was well-executed (I recommend pre-heating the potatoes before serving to enhance the texture and tenderness).
Payment accepted: cash or bank transfer.

originalText.text:
看到家人介紹剛好經過中山捷運附近，
就覺得下午時間過來轉轉
小小的空間吧檯座位有7個、5張2人位空間舒適不擁擠。
寵物友善空間、不落地
之前嘗過某連鎖路xx的西西里氣泡咖啡，
帶著忐忑心情想不到是好喝的～～
而且店員擔心氣泡影響臘腸狗冰塊浮不起來還幫我另外放讓我自己加入，想不到效果還不錯🤣
因為等下還要用餐，所以烤溫沙拉有請他出小一點，所以不確定照片內容物是否為正確$180份量，但撒上香料的溫沙拉著實讓人心情愉悅！但馬鈴薯可再軟嫩些，其餘的口感掌握的不錯（建議馬鈴薯可以先處理再一起熱一下出餐口感及馬鈴薯嫩度可凸顯出來）
可以付現、轉帳

text.text: As someone who's quite picky about food, I genuinely thought this brunch was delicious. I ordered the upgraded set meal with a seared cheese and soft-boiled egg croissant. The lettuce salad was of high quality, and the sesame dressing was delicious. The croissant paired perfectly with the hot cheese and soft-boiled egg, a wonderful balance of sweet and savory. Afterwards, I had a brown sugar yogurt cup, which wasn't too sweet and left me wanting more. The restaurant had a comfortable atmosphere with pleasant jazz music playing, making it very relaxing. This meal was very satisfying; highly recommended! ❤️

originalText.text: 對於餐點很挑嘴的我，真心覺得這家早午餐好好吃，點了炙燒起司嫩蛋可頌升級套餐，生菜沙拉食材不馬虎淋上胡麻醬很可口，可頌配上熱熱起司嫩蛋鹹甜鹹甜很搭，餐後再來個黑糖優格杯，不甜有點意猶未盡想再來一個。店內環境很舒適，配上好聽爵士音樂很舒服，今天這一餐滿足了我的胃，推推唷❤️

text.text:
A very cozy and lovely little shop!! The service was also excellent.

I ordered the truffle and wild mushroom croissant; the bread was delicious, and they gave me a lot of lettuce! The truffle flavor was incredibly rich, I loved it!

The brown sugar ginger tea was also very good, perfect for this weather.

I've had the brown sugar milk before, which was also very good. I'll definitely visit this shop again.
